cohort: Parent participants (37 mothers, 27 fathers) of children newly diagnosed with differences/disorders of sex development (DSDs).
finding: Younger gestational age was associated with increased depressive symptoms, particularly for mothers compared to fathers, suggesting premature birth may predispose parents of infants with DSD to distress.
mod_finding: Findings for the delivery method (mode of birth) were not significant regarding parental depressive and anxious symptoms.
gest_age: Infants with DSD, specifically gestational ages of 36, 38, and 40 weeks were examined.
